cues.zh: 我想给你们看一串有趣的数字。
cues.en: Well, I wanted to show you an interesting sequence of numbers.

cues.zh: [继续] 那么开始吧，我从这里开始
cues.en: [Go on] So here we go I'm going to start here

cues.zh: 你可能注意到，我这儿那儿漏掉了几项
cues.en: Well, you might notice that I'm missing out a couple here and there

cues.zh: 大部分都在这里，但仔细看会发现，这里缺了4和5……
cues.en: Most of them are here but if you look carefully you'll see that here we are missing four and five...

cues.zh: 下面这里应该缺了13和14；23和22；31和32。
cues.en: and down here we should be missing thirteen and fourteen; 23 and 22; 31 and 32.

cues.zh: 有一个假设，或者说猜想：所有这些数都能写成三个整数立方之和。
cues.en: Well, there's a supposition, or a conjecture, that all of these numbers can be written as a sum of three cubes of integers.

cues.zh: 最好用例子来说明
cues.en: Most probably best done by example

cues.zh: 比如拿这里的29来说，这意味着我可以把它写成三个整数立方之和
cues.en: If I take this number here for example, 29, it means that I can write this as a sum of three cubes of integers

cues.zh: 在这个例子里，它可以写成3的立方加1的立方，3的立方是27，加1的立方是28，再加1的立方是29。
cues.en: And in this case it can be written as three cubed plus one cubed, so three cubed is 27, plus one cubed is 28, plus one cubed is 29.

cues.zh: 所以人们认为所有其他整数也都有类似的表示形式
cues.en: So it's thought that all of the other integers have a similar representation

cues.zh: 我得指出，你也可以用负数来表示
cues.en: And I should point out you are allowed to represent your number by negative numbers as well

cues.zh: 也就是说，你求三个立方和时，其中一个……或多个整数可以是负数
cues.en: So you're allowed to take sums of three cubes in which one of the.. or more of the integers is a negative number

cues.zh: 非常惊人的是，即使在这张列表上的某些数字，
cues.en: What's quite striking is that for some of the numbers, even on this very list,

cues.zh: 要写出这个问题的解也出奇地困难
cues.en: it's actually surprisingly difficult to write down the solution to the problem

cues.zh: 为了说明我的意思，我们顺着这行看过来，看到数字 30，我需要再多一点空间，
cues.en: To illustrate what I mean we just have to go a little bit along the line here to number 30, and I'm going to need a little bit more space,

cues.zh: 不过你也许想大胆猜猜看这个问题的解是什么……？
cues.en: but maybe you would care to hazard a guess as to what the solution to this problem is...?

cues.zh: [这个容易吗？还是很难？……] -笑
cues.en: [Is it an easy one? is it a hard one? ...] -laughing

cues.zh: 这很难。我得说，这个解直到 1999 年才被发现
cues.en: It's a hard one. I should say that this was only discovered in 1999

cues.zh: 它是用计算机算出来的，我觉得其实挺让人吃惊的。
cues.en: It was discovered by computer, it's actually quite surprising I think.

cues.zh: 准备好了吗？[准备好了] 好，开始吧
cues.en: So, are you ready? [I'm ready] OK, let's go

cues.zh: 我不得不把这些写下来，不过开始吧
cues.en: I have had to write this down, but let's go

cues.zh: 二……二、二、零……四、二、二、九、三、二……全部立方，
cues.en: Two... two, two, zero... four, two, two, nine, three, two... all cubed,

cues.zh: 加上负二、一、二、八……[那是个负数] 这就是那个负数
cues.en: plus minus two, one, two, eight.... [That was a negative number] This is the negative number

cues.zh: 这里还有一个负数：负二八三，零五九，九五六。全部立方
cues.en: And there's one more negative number here: minus two eight three comma, zero five nine comma, nine five six. All cubed

cues.zh: [太神奇了！] 是的，我觉得相当惊人
cues.en: [That's amazing!] Yes it's quite striking I think

cues.zh: 没错。所以，随着你继续往上查这个列表，你会发现这种现象持续出现
cues.en: That's right. So, as you carry on up the list you'll find this phenomena continuing

cues.zh: 所以，有些情况下你能找到非常小的解，
cues.en: So, some occasions where you'll be able to find very small solutions,

cues.zh: 而就在它旁边，会出现一个似乎有着极大解的数字
cues.en: and then just next door to it there'll be a number cropping up which seems to have enormously large solutions

cues.zh: 遗憾的是，是的。我后面会回到这些，但下一个符合条件的数字是33
cues.en: Sadly, yes. I'm going to come back to these ones, but the next eligible one is this number 33

cues.zh: 而且，事实上，我们仍然不知道那个的答案。
cues.en: And, in fact, we still don't know an answer to that one.

cues.zh: 所以我们目前还没找到任何整数，能让它们的立方和等于 33。
cues.en: So we've not yet been able to find any integers which when you sum their cubes you can get 33.

cues.zh: 搜索已经相当彻底了，目前他们已经算到了……
cues.en: Search has been pretty thorough, so far they've gone up to...

cues.zh: 我想他们已经搜到了 10 的 14 次方大小的数；也就是 1 后面跟着 14 个零。
cues.en: I think they've gone up to the numbers of size ten to the fourteen; so it's one with fourteen zeros after it

cues.zh: 在这个范围内，没有找到任何解。
cues.en: Within that range, there are no solutions.

cues.zh: 这是个非常好的问题，之前有人试图证明这个数字根本不在解的名单上……
cues.en: That's a very good question, and there have been some attempts to prove that this number isn't on the list...

cues.zh: 但那些尝试都失败了。因此它依然在名单上，而且第一个解可能就是个天文数字，这完全有可能。
cues.en: but, those attempts have failed. Therefore it is, and it's perfectly allowable that the first solution might just be ginormous.

cues.zh: 有些数确实不在名单上。我来跟你们讲讲那些被排除掉的数。
cues.en: There are numbers that are off the list. Let me tell you about the numbers off the list
So I'll just write them down again: so we had four, five, thirteen, fourteen, 22, 23, 31, 32.

cues.zh: 你可能会好奇这些数字有什么共同点
cues.en: So you might wonder what those numbers have in common

cues.zh: [它们做错了什么？]——笑声
cues.en: [What have they done wrong?] -laughing

cues.zh: 嗯，啊，它们的“大罪”在于，它们都能写成 9 乘以某个整数，也就是 9K 加 4，或者 9K 加 5
cues.en: Well, ah, their great crime is that they can all be written as nine times an integer, so nine times an integer, K, plus four, or nine times an integer K plus five

cues.zh: 比如 4 显然就是 9 乘以 0，再加 4
cues.en: So for example four is clearly nine times zero, plus four

cues.zh: 再比如这里的 31，是 9 乘以 3 得 27，再加 4
cues.en: And for example, 31 here is nine times three, which is 27, plus four

cues.zh: 所以它们都符合这个条件
cues.en: So they all meet this criteria

cues.zh: 而且，只要你写下任何这种形式的数，9K 加 4，或者 9K 加 5
cues.en: And indeed, if you write down any number which is of this shape, nine times K plus four, or nine times K plus five

cues.zh: 它就永远不可能写成三个立方数之和。这一点我们其实可以证明。
cues.en: It will never be written as the sum of three cubes. And that's something we can actually prove.

cues.zh: 我是说，这里到底怎么回事，我们看的是这种形式的方程，比如 A 的立方加 B 的立方加 C 的立方等于，比方说 33
cues.en: I mean, what's going on here, we're looking at equations of this shape, for example A cubed, plus B cubed, plus C cubed equal to, say for example, 33

cues.zh: 这就是所谓的丢番图方程的一个例子——这是数论中一个非常核心的主题
cues.en: So this is an example of what's called a Diophantine equation - and this is a very central topic in number theory

cues.zh: 它被研究了，我得说，很多很多年，所以它们以一位叫丢番图的人命名，他大约生活在公元 250 年，是希腊人
cues.en: It's been studied, I would say, for lots of years, so they're named after someone called Diophantus, who lived in about 250AD, a Greek

cues.zh: 但思考这类问题其实还要更早，大概 4000 年前，可以追溯到巴比伦人
cues.en: But thinking about problems like this goes back even further, some 4000 years, to the Babylonians

cues.zh: 但问题是，如果你有这样一个多项式方程，你首先能不能判断它在整数里有没有解——这正是我们在这个特殊情形下想做的事
cues.en: But the question is, if you have a polynomial equation like this, can you first of all decide whether it has solutions in integers - that's what we're trying to do in this special case

cues.zh: 如果它确实有解，你甚至可以问有多少个解——是无穷多个，还是仅仅，哦你知道，就一小把？
cues.en: If it does have solutions you could even ask how many are there - are there infinitely many, or just, oh you know, just a handful?

cues.zh: 如果有无穷多个，你能在某种意义上描述它们的频率吗？
cues.en: And if there are infinitely many, can you describe their frequency in some sense?

cues.zh: 这正是我积极从事的研究领域。
cues.en: And this is the sort of area of research that I'm actively engaged with.

cues.zh: 所以我们还没有证明它在整数中有解。
cues.en: So we do not have a proof that this has solutions, in integers.

cues.zh: 目前只是猜想它在整数中有解。
cues.en: It is conjectured that this has solutions in integers

cues.zh: 目前我们能做的，就只是用计算机试着把它们找出来。
cues.en: All that we can hope to do, at the moment, is just use a computer and try and find them

cues.zh: 绝对是的。绝对。
cues.en: Absolutely, yes. Absolutely

cues.zh: 所以我只是想回到我们这里列出的第一个数字，实际上，就是数字一。
cues.en: So I just wanted to go back to the first number on the list that we had up here, actually, number one.

cues.zh: 你知道，我们不需要花太多时间苦思冥想就能想出这个的解。
cues.en: You know, we're not going to have to spend too much time scratching our heads to come up with a solution to this one.

cues.zh: 对吧？我们可以选……你想猜一下吗？——（笑）[对，1的立方，0的立方，0的立方]
cues.en: Right? We could take... you want to have a guess? - laughs [Yep, one cubed, zero cubed, zero cubed]

cues.zh: 好，这挺简单的。所以至少有一个解，你可能会问，还有别的解吗？
cues.en: OK so that was easy. So there's at least one solution, and you might ask, you know, are there others?

cues.zh: 我来写另一个解：你可以把 1 写成 10 的立方，加上 9 的立方，再减去 12 的立方。
cues.en: I'm going to write another solution: you can write one as ten cubed, plus nine cubed, minus twelve cubed.

cues.zh: 看过你出租车数视频的人可能会对这个式子有点兴奋，不过……我们在这里就不展开了……
cues.en: So people that have seen your taxi cab video might get a bit excited about that particular one but... let's not go into that here...

cues.zh: [好吧，所以你有……所以有两种解法！] 两种解法！而且在这个特例中，实际上有无穷多种解法。
cues.en: [Alright, so you've got... so there are two ways to do this!] Two ways to do this! And in fact there are infinitely many ways to do this in this particular case.

cues.zh: 而且写出一个所谓的参数解并不难。
cues.en: And it's not hard to write down what's called a parametric solution.

cues.zh: 我把 1 写成 (1 + 9M³)³，
cues.en: So I'm writing one as one plus nine M cubed, all cubed,

cues.zh: 加上 (9M⁴)³，
cues.en: plus nine M to the four, all cubed,

cues.zh: 再加上 (-9M⁴ - 3M)³，
cues.en: plus minus nine M to the four minus three M, all cubed

cues.zh: 关键在于，这个式子对任意 M 都成立。
cues.en: and the point of this is that this is valid for any M.

cues.zh: 是的，所以在第一种情况下，如果我令 M 等于 0，我得到 1、0、0
cues.en: Yeah, so in the first case if I put in M equal to zero, I get one, zero, zero

cues.zh: 如果我令 M 等于 1，我得到 10、9 和 -12。
cues.en: If I put M equal to one, I get ten, nine, and minus twelve.

cues.zh: 但你可以代入任何值，然后就会得到海量的解。
cues.en: But you could put anything in, and you'd just get tonnes and tonnes of solutions.

cues.zh: 所以是的，在我一开始列出的清单里，1 有点特殊，因为实际上，它是……
cues.en: So yeah, in the list that I started with one is a bit special, in that, in fact, it's...

cues.zh: 存在这个参数化解族，而且有无穷多种不同的方式把 1 写成三个立方数之和。
cues.en: there's this parametric family of solutions, and there are infinitely many different ways of writing one as a sum of three cubes.

cues.zh: 实际上拥有这类参数化解的例子相对很少
cues.en: There are relatively few examples where we actually have these parametric solutions

cues.zh: 如果我们回到之前看过的一个例子，比如这个数字 30
cues.en: And if we go back to one of the examples we saw before, so for example, this number 30

cues.zh: 有人怀疑不存在参数化解
cues.en: It's suspected that there are not parametric solutions

cues.zh: ——尽管实际上有人怀疑确实存在无穷多个解，
cues.en: - although in fact it is suspected that there are in fact infinitely many solutions,

cues.zh: 但是……它们增长得非常非常快
cues.en: but... they just get big very very quickly

cues.zh: 所以当你衡量它们的密度时，总体上的解非常少。
cues.en: And so as you measure their density there are very few solutions overall.

cues.zh: 参数解法的关键在于，解有一个公式。
cues.en: The whole point about a parametric solution is that there is a formula for the solutions.

cues.zh: 你只需代入数字，它就会给出一些答案
cues.en: You can just plug in numbers and it'll give you some answers

cues.zh: 但其他这些例子并非如此……
cues.en: That's not the case for these other examples...

cues.zh: 或者说，人们怀疑其他这些例子并非如此——你得费很大劲才能找到它们。
cues.en: or, it's suspected to not be the case for these other examples - you have to work quite hard to find them.
